title: Level 5 (World Class) - A-4
notes:
West leads the ♣J against 4♥. West's club lead is taken by East. East returns a club, won by South. South needs 3-2 trumps and East to have the ♦K. South must play carefully to handle a 4-2 diamond break.

To guard against a defender holding 3 hearts and 4 diamonds South should duck a diamond at trick 3. South wins the trump return, draws a second round of trump, and crosses in spades. South now takes the diamond finesse, cashes the ♦A, and if a diamond is still outstanding ruffs his last diamond in dummy. South will lose a trump trick at the end.
